function ctaEncrypt(sInput) {
    var icLen = sInput.length;
    var icNewText = "";
    var sInchar = "";

    for (var i = 0; i < icLen; i++) {
        sInchar = sInput.charAt(i);

        switch (sInchar.charCodeAt(0)) {
            case 65:
            case 66:
            case 67:
            case 68:
            case 69:
            case 70:
            case 71:
            case 72:
            case 73:
            case 74:
            case 75:
            case 76:
            case 77:
            case 78:
            case 79:
            case 80:
            case 81:
            case 82:
            case 83:
            case 84:
            case 85:
            case 86:
            case 87:
            case 88:
            case 89:
            case 90:
                sInchar = String.fromCharCode(sInchar.charCodeAt(0) + 127);
                break;

            case 97:
            case 98:
            case 99:
            case 100:
            case 101:
            case 102:
            case 103:
            case 104:
            case 105:
            case 106:
            case 107:
            case 108:
            case 109:
            case 110:
            case 111:
            case 112:
            case 113:
            case 114:
            case 115:
            case 116:
            case 117:
            case 118:
            case 119:
            case 120:
            case 121:
            case 122:
                sInchar = String.fromCharCode(sInchar.charCodeAt(0) + 121);
                break;

            case 48:
            case 49:
            case 50:
            case 51:
            case 52:
            case 53:
            case 54:
            case 55:
            case 56:
            case 57:
                sInchar = String.fromCharCode(sInchar.charCodeAt(0) + 196);
                break;

            case 32:
                sInchar = String.fromCharCode(32);
                break;

            default:
                sInchar = String.fromCharCode(sInchar.charCodeAt(0) + 0);
        }

        icNewText += sInchar;
    }

    return icNewText;
}
